actor_loss.formula: -lambda * mean_i[Q1(s_i, pi(s_i)) - k * W(s_i, pi(s_i))] + mean_ij (pi(s_i)_j - a_ij)^2
actor_loss.frozen: W's own parameters (critic, classifier, surface, constants) get no gradient; W acts on the actor only through the command
actor_loss.lam: lambda = alpha / stopgrad(mean_i |Q1(s_i, pi(s_i))|), on Q1 alone
actor_loss.w0: with k W = 0 the loss is the room's and learners.actor_step's unweighted expression

check_e: every seed and world, before any arm is trained, on every penalty (the 8 families): the room's rule (harness.oracle_shape) for any penalty: on the room's 2,000 full-throttle-region training states (default_rng([20261015, seed, 65])) thruster 1 of the no-caution actor's command is set along the actor's own push to each throttle of the room's grid; (e1) W falls from 80% to 81% on at most 25% of them, (e2) mean W rises from 80% to 81%, (e3) the in-program penalty's mean slope along the push at 80.5% is positive and every slope finite, (e4) the best grid throttle for Q1 - k W lies past 80% on fewer states than for Q1 alone, k the coefficient of ladder knob 1 (also reported per rung). Reported; not a stop condition (deviations).

checks.b: the stand-in program with W = 0 matches check 2's actor within 1e-5 on every parameter (each seed and world; stop on failure)
checks.row_stream: the batch-row stream's SHA-256 equals the room lock's check-(a) record (stop otherwise)
checks.seed0_d: seed 0: a 400-step run of every arm (each family at knob 1, and W = 0) in both worlds, 200-step chunks (two classifier refits), finite; W = 0 against the room's RoomRunner (parameter hash); timing
checks.seed0_f: seed 0: each penalty finite and nonnegative with finite gradients on every training row at the recorded, cloned, no-caution and uniform commands, both worlds

code: runs/shift_explore/standins/code_manifest.json: every phase and check refuses unless each listed script and its copy under code/ have the recorded SHA-256 and the manifest names this spec

data_side.classifier: see deviations; refitted every 4,000 steps per arm
data_side.cloned_actor: c(s): the saved cloned actor of the world (check 2's start actor)
data_side.density: sigma_k^2 = mean_i (a_ik - c_k(s_i))^2 over the training rows (maximum likelihood with mean c); N(s_i, a_i) precomputed per row; q95_N on the held-out rows
data_side.distance: see deviations (standard units, exact d10, surface); f(s_i, a_i) precomputed per row
data_side.two_head: D(s_i, a_i) precomputed per row with the frozen critic

deviations: Stand-in forms (F1-F3): density, distance to data and two-head disagreement are read from the row's recorded command, [x(s, a) - x(s, a_i)]_+, following change A1 of the room spec; the plan's literal forms run beside them as reported arms (density_plan, distance_plan, two_head_plan) with the same matching, evaluation and marks, labelled reported. The choice was made from frozen surfaces only, before any stand-in training. NEEDS THE USER'S APPROVAL before launch: it changes the plan's stand-in formulas. Nothing in the code enforces this.
Range hinge: matched in strength like every stand-in (plan 4.2), with the room's definition unchanged; the room test ran it unmatched at k = 1 as a reported arm.

Classifier ratio. The classifier g has the shape of BCA's scale network (64-64 ReLU, restated; calibration/ is not imported) with the logit as output, so log w = logit. Target pairs (s_i, clip(pi(s_i) + a_i - c(s_i), -1, 1)) against recorded pairs (s_i, a_i) at the same training rows, balanced, logistic loss, 2,000 Adam steps (lr 1e-3) of 512 rows from a fixed row stream (default_rng([20261015, seed, 82])) and a fixed initialisation (tag 84), refitted before every 4,000-step chunk (steps 0, 4,000, ..., 16,000) with the arm's own actor; the first fit uses the start actor (the cloned actor), so its target pairs equal the recorded pairs and the penalty starts near zero. l* is computed directly from the bank weights, without BCA's code, as the plain weighted split-conformal limit at miscoverage 0.1: the threshold becomes +infinity when the test weight exceeds 0.1 / 0.9 times the bank's weight sum, so l* = log(0.1 / 0.9) + log sum_bank w(s_j, a_j); BCA's credible (Bayesian) layer is not restated. The bank is the gapped log's calibration bank (prepared.bank, the rows the gate's loader regenerates). U_max, BCA's largest finite width, does not exist without BCA; the matched coefficient takes its place.

Distance surface (the plan says only 'fitted as a surface'). Standard units: per-dimension mean and SD of the training rows' (state, command), 13 + 4 dimensions, as the fallback diagnostic. Exact d10 (float32 candidate search, float64 distances) at 120,000 fit queries and 20,000 validation queries: training states drawn uniformly with commands of six kinds (recorded; cloned actor; no-caution actor; uniform; recorded + normal noise 0.25; no-caution actor with one thruster at 0.6-1.0 on its own side), default_rng([20261015, seed, 83]). Surface: MLP 17-128-128-1, softplus activations and output; 12,000 Adam steps of 1,024 queries, cosine decay 1e-3 -> 5e-5, fixed initialisation (tag 85) and row stream (tag 86). Fit error is reported overall, at past-80% queries and at held-out recorded rows. q95_d of the plan's form is the exact d10's level on the held-out rows; the surface's own level is reported.

Held-out recorded rows (plan: 'held-out recorded rows'): 5,000 rows of the calibration split with the gap removed and the calibration-bank rows left out, default_rng([20261015, seed, 81]); q95 is the split-conformal level ceil((n + 1) 0.95) / n, as the fallback diagnostic.

Ladder (plan: '4-rung ladder, then refinement', rungs not given): knobs 0.3, 1, 3, 10, slope-normalised: the coefficient of knob 1 is g_band / g_X, the RMS command slope of the room's main oracle over that of the stand-in, both at the no-caution actor's commands on the room's 4,096 slope rows. The room normalised at the cloned actor's commands, where most stand-ins here are exactly zero (they are zero at or near the recorded command), so that point gives no scale. The room's blind extension rule (x sqrt(10), at most 3 rungs) and the gate's matcher (glq_match.match_parallel, tol 0.01, at most 5 rounds, knob 0 = no caution leading the ladder) are used unchanged; the chosen arm is the evaluated knob with the best |S/S* - 1|.

Check (e) is run on every penalty before any training and reported; it is not a stop condition for the stand-ins. Reason: these are rivals that set the bar BCA must meet; dropping one that does not rise past the knee would lower that bar, and whether a data-only penalty rises past 80% is itself what the check asks. (e4) needs a coefficient: the one of ladder knob 1 (reported at every rung too). The classifier ratio is read with its classifier fitted with the no-caution actor (and, reported, with the cloned actor).

Marks wording made exact, as in the room spec: each condition is on the pooled mean over seeds 0-4 of the paired per-seed difference; every seed is needed (a missing value or an unmatched stand-in fails the mark). The perfect band, the matched even pull and the room's no-caution points come from the room's verified values.json, read only in the marks phase; the stand-ins' no-caution points come from this component's own evaluation of the same saved actor, and the difference from the room's is reported (it should be 0).

A stand-in whose target strength cannot be reached (no bracket after the extensions) has no matched arm and fails every mark, as in the room; its strongest finite rung is evaluated and reported, labelled unmatched.

No-stall world: every stand-in runs at its stalling-world locked coefficient (absolute, not re-matched), with its data side refitted on the no-stall world's own gapped log (range, sigma, q95, distance surface, classifier refits with the no-stall arm's own actor, the no-stall critic's two heads); critic: check 2's no-stall gapped critic; start: the no-stall cloned actor; check (b) against check 2's no-stall gapped actor (stop on failure).

The no-stall loss is read in strong current, the situation of the stalling-world gain, and reported in every situation; selectivity = stalling-world gain minus no-stall loss (both strong current), compared with the matched range hinge by the paired per-seed difference.
evaluation: acceptance._evaluate (learners.evaluate_actor): exact 100-step returns on the full 1,000-start banks of the four situations, points against the gate's anchors, capped at 80%, share past 80%; plus, reported, the share past 80% per thruster. Scored: none (check 2's saved actor), the cloned actor, the matched arm of every family and, for an unmatched family, its strongest finite rung (reported). No-stall world: none, the cloned actor and every family at its locked coefficient.

evidence.note: scratch scripts that measured the frozen surfaces behind F1-F3 before any stand-in training (no return, points or strength); hashed here for provenance

form_choices.id: F1 behaviour density read from the row's recorded command
form_choices.main_form: [N(s_i, a) - N(s_i, a_i)]_+, N(s, a) = 1/2 sum_k ((a_k - c_k(s)) / sigma_k)^2, c the cloned actor, sigma_k^2 = mean_i (a_ik - c_k(s_i))^2 over the training rows (maximum likelihood)
form_choices.plan_form_runs_as: density_plan (reported; the same matching, evaluation and marks, labelled reported)
form_choices.reason: Meaning. N(s, a) is how unusual the command is for the recorder at this state, in units of the recorder's spread. The plan's threshold q95 is one number for the whole log, so the penalty asks 'is this command less usual than 95% of recorded commands anywhere'. Measuring from the row's own recorded command asks 'is this command less usual for the recorder at this state than the command the recorder actually gave here', which is change A1's reading (W = 0 at a = a_i, one-sided, it removes exactly the extra unusualness and never rewards a command for being usual). Why the global level fails here: the recorder's spread is wide and heavy-tailed across the log (sigma 0.21-0.23 per thruster on seed 0; q95 of N on held-out recorded rows 7.46 against 4.74 for a Gaussian), so on seed 0 the plan's form is positive at only 1.1% of the 2,000 region states with thruster 1 at 80% and 2.4% at full throttle; the read-from-the-recorded-command form is positive at 56% and 86%, falls from 80% to 81% at 0.1% of them and rises on 58%. Measured on frozen surfaces before any stand-in training (scratchpad/ood/standins/explore/shapes.py); no return, points or strength.

form_choices.id: F2 distance to data read from the row's recorded command
form_choices.main_form: [f(s_i, a) - f(s_i, a_i)]_+, f a smooth surface (MLP) fitted to d10(s, a), the distance to the 10th-nearest training row in standard units of (state, command)
form_choices.reason: Meaning. d10 measures how far the (state, command) pair is from the data; at training states its level is set mostly by where the state is, not by the command (the fallback diagnostic found the same: swapping a harmful command for its clipped version moved the median distance from 4.26 to 4.06 standard units against a threshold of 4.30). That state-set level is an offset unrelated to the command, the reason change A1 measured the oracle from the recorded command. [f(s, a) - f(s, a_i)]_+ keeps what the command adds to the distance at this state. On seed 0 (exact kNN, 2,000 region states): the plan's form is positive at 6.9% of them at 80% and 8.0% at full throttle (mean d10 2.73 and 2.98 against q95 4.27); the chosen form is positive at 63% and 95%, falls from 80% to 81% at 0.4% and rises on 65% (on the fitted surface: falls at 0%, rises on 66%). Frozen surfaces only.

form_choices.id: F3 two-head disagreement read from the row's recorded command
form_choices.main_form: [D(s_i, a) - D(s_i, a_i)]_+, D(s, a) = |Q1(s, a) - Q2(s, a)| of the frozen critic
form_choices.reason: Meaning. |Q1 - Q2| at the recorded command is an offset set by the state and by the two heads' random initialisation, not by the command, and as an absolute value of a signed gap it can fall as the command moves (as the literal |delta*| did). [D(s, a) - D(s, a_i)]_+ keeps the extra disagreement the command causes at this state. On seed 0 the literal form falls from 80% to 81% on 43.9% of the region states (check (e1) allows 25%), the chosen form on 23.6%. The signal is weak either way (mean D 0.107 at 70% throttle, 0.123 at full). Frozen surfaces only.

form_choices.id: F4 range hinge and classifier ratio kept in the plan's form
form_choices.reason: The range hinge is the room's arm, reused unchanged: it is zero inside the recorded range, so it already reads relative to the recorded commands (and is zero at 99% of them). The classifier ratio is a density ratio of the actor's pairs against the recorded pairs at the same states, with l* set by the bank's recorded pairs; at recorded commands log w is about 0, far below l* (about 4.3-4.5 on seed 0), so softplus(log w - l*) is already near 0 there (0.01) and re-referencing would change almost nothing while adding a kink.

label: EXPLORATORY: Stage 1 data-only stand-ins in the lower-edge channel (plan section 4.2), computed outside the gate on saved gate artifacts and the room test's locked strengths; not a gated output; changes no pre-registered rule; no BCA band, calibrator, threshold, dose or BCA update was used (data-only stand-ins only)

ladder.chosen_arm: the evaluated knob with the best |S/S* - 1| (glq_match's record)
ladder.scale: kappa_X = g_band / g_X at the no-caution actor's commands (deviations)
ladder.target: the room's perfect band's strength of the same seed, lock.json target_strength (S = RMS change of the command from no caution on the 5,000 evaluation-split states)
ladder.unmatched: no matched arm: every mark fails; the strongest finite rung is evaluated and reported

lock: after every arm is trained and matched, lock.json (+ .sha256) holds every actor's parameter SHA-256, the actors file's SHA-256, strengths, matches, coefficients, checks (b) and (e), the data-side fit reports, the spec's and the code manifest's SHA-256 and the room files read. No return, points or score of any trained arm is computed before it exists; every evaluation verifies it first

marks.captures_the_room: a stand-in captures the room when all three hold: (1) its matched gain over no caution in strong current is at least 50% of the perfect band's gain; (2) it scores at least no caution - 3 in recorded conditions; (3) it beats the matched even pull by at least 15 points in strong current
marks.expected_by_the_plan: the range hinge and behaviour density capture most of the room in the stalling world, and every stand-in costs points in the no-stall world; this sets the bar for BCA; it is not evidence for BCA
marks.pooled: each condition on the pooled mean over seeds 0-4 of the paired per-seed difference; every seed needed; computed for the five stand-ins (the mark) and for the three literal forms (reported)
marks.reported: each stand-in's no-stall loss at its locked scale (no caution minus the stand-in, no-stall world, strong current; every situation reported); selectivity = stalling-world gain minus no-stall loss; selectivity minus the range hinge's (paired)

no_bca: No BCA band, calibrator, threshold, dose, BCA update or BCA training arm. Nothing from algorithms/td3_bc_bca.py or learners.bca_* is called. From calibration/ only calibration/bank.stratified_bank runs, inside the gate's data loader. The classifier and the distance surface are new data-only networks; the classifier's l* is a closed-form count over the bank's classifier weights, not BCA's threshold rule.

room.imported: runs/shift_explore/room/code/harness.py, executed from the bytes whose SHA-256 the room's code manifest records (the manifest checked against its sidecar and the pinned SHA-256; the room's source file checked too); refuse on any mismatch
room.read: train: runs/shift_explore/room/pooled.json's pass flags (the run condition) and seed<k>/lock.json's target_strength (the perfect band's strength), its check-(a) row-stream SHA-256 and its 'none' actor SHA-256; marks: seed<k>/values.json's points of perfect_band, the matched even pull and none. Nothing else of the room's outputs is read.
room.reused: SeedContext (the gate's loaders), hinge_bounds and HINGE_SCALE (the range hinge), build_shared and slope_rms (the room's main-oracle slope for the ladder scale), shape_rows, SHAPE_GRID, SHAPE_GRAD_POINTS, SHAPE_MAX_FALL_SHARE (check (e)), region_strength, max_param_diff, gate_file_hashes; RoomRunner only in the seed-0 check (d)

run_condition: plan 4.2: the stand-ins run only if the room test's room, recovery and cost (keeps-improvement) marks pass: every train phase refuses unless runs/shift_explore/room/pooled.json matches its sidecar, is the room harness's labelled pooled look for the pinned spec, is complete and its room, recovery and keeps_improvement marks passed
run_order: 0. the room test's pooled look passes (room, recovery, keeps improvement) and the user approves F1-F3; 1. per seed 0-4: train, eval, no_stall_train, no_stall_eval (one pinned process per seed); 2. marks over seeds 0-4. Logs: runs/shift_explore/standins/logs/.

setup.arms_side_by_side: the arms of one kind run vmapped in one program
setup.critic: check 2's frozen fixed-controller gapped critic of the stalling world (no-stall twin)
setup.protocol: the room test's (plan 4.0): check 2's actor-only protocol, unchanged
setup.start_actor: the saved cloned actor of the world

classifier_ratio.W: softplus(log w(s_i, a) - l*), log w = the logit of a classifier g of target pairs (s_i, clip(pi(s_i) + a_i - c(s_i), -1, 1)) against recorded pairs (s_i, a_i), refitted every 4,000 steps with the arm's own actor; l* = log(0.1 / 0.9 * sum_{j in bank} w(s_j, a_j))

density.W: [N(s_i, a) - N(s_i, a_i)]_+, N(s, a) = 1/2 sum_k ((a_k - c_k(s)) / sigma_k)^2, c the cloned actor, sigma_k^2 = mean_i (a_ik - c_k(s_i))^2 over the training rows (maximum likelihood)

density_plan.W: [N(s_i, a) - q95_N]_+, q95_N the split-conformal 95% level of N on 5,000 held-out recorded rows
density_plan.role: the plan's literal form (reported; same mark computed, labelled reported)

distance.W: [f(s_i, a) - f(s_i, a_i)]_+, f a smooth surface (MLP) fitted to d10(s, a), the distance to the 10th-nearest training row in standard units of (state, command)

distance_plan.W: [f(s_i, a) - q95_d]_+, q95_d the split-conformal 95% level of the exact d10 on 5,000 held-out recorded rows
distance_plan.role: the plan's literal form (reported; same mark computed, labelled reported)

range_hinge.W: 100 * sum_j ([a_j - hi_j]_+^2 + [lo_j - a_j]_+^2), lo_j, hi_j the 0.5% and 99.5% quantiles of the gapped training commands per thruster (the room's range_hinge, unchanged)

two_head.W: [D(s_i, a) - D(s_i, a_i)]_+, D(s, a) = |Q1(s, a) - Q2(s, a)| of the frozen critic

two_head_plan.W: |Q1(s_i, a) - Q2(s_i, a)| of the frozen critic (the plan's literal form)
two_head_plan.role: the plan's literal form (reported; same mark computed, labelled reported)

strength.definition: learners.strength on prepared.eval_obs against check 2's saved actor (the room's)
strength.region_check: the same on the full-throttle-region training states, reported

user_approval: F1-F3 change the plan's stand-in formulas (the literal forms still run, reported). Launch only after the user approves them. Nothing in the code enforces this.
